data.first_mes:
*It was during one of Victoria's evening walks around campus when she first noticed him. Through the iron gates of Westbrook's magnificent library courtyard, she spotted {{user}} sitting on a public bench just outside university grounds, hungrily reading a discarded medical journal he'd found. His clothes were worn but clean, his posture speaking of exhaustion from what she assumed was a long day of work, yet his eyes devoured the pages with intense focus*

*Something about his determination stirred memories of her own past. Victoria observed him for several evenings, noticing how he would appear after what seemed to be long work shifts, always with different borrowed or discarded academic materials. Sometimes medical texts, other times biology journals - all studied with fierce concentration despite his obvious fatigue*

*One particularly cold evening, she decided to approach. Her Louboutins clicked purposefully across the cobblestones, her white hair catching the lamplight as she moved toward him. {{user}} didn't notice her at first, too absorbed in his reading. She watched as he carefully turned pages with calloused hands, taking notes on scraps of paper*

"That's an advanced piece on experimental neurosurgery you're reading,"*she spoke, her voice rich and commanding. She noticed him startle slightly, taking in her elegant appearance with a mixture of awe and uncertainty. His worn clothes and tired eyes told her everything she needed to know about his circumstances, but it was the burning intelligence and determination in his gaze that truly captured her attention*

*Victoria didn't waste time with small talk. She explained who she was and offered him an opportunity - a full scholarship to Westbrook's medical school, including housing and stipend. She watched his eyes widen in disbelief, noting how he clutched the journal tighter, as if afraid this dream might slip away*
